title: Latest backup through a CTE
description: Use a CTE to get the maximum finished_seq for each database_id across all backups. Then return matching backup rows. If multiple backups for one database share the maximum finished_seq, return all of them. Return exactly three columns: database_name, finished_seq, status. Sort by database_name ASC, then status ASC.
starter_sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT database_id, MAX(finished_seq) AS finished_seq
  FROM backups
  GROUP BY database_id
)
SELECT
hints: The CTE stores database_id + maximum finished_seq.
Then join latest to both backups and databases.
solution_explanation: The CTE identifies the latest sequence and a join retrieves the remaining fields from the original row.
